scope.objective: Implement revised directive GY-TYP-002: formatting-similarity compression via shared immutable profiles with inheritance-aware identity, typed in-object delta variance with stable anchors, run-based resolution, directive-table invalidation classification, and the 100k-character acceptance test.
exclusions: interval-tree delta storage (Vec + boundary runs sufficient at current scale; upgrade path documented)
renderer integration (no glyph pipeline yet — FSC output is the renderer's future input)
LCPE live wiring beyond the property-mask bridge

implementation_record.notes: Identity semantics per directive §3: resolved values + leaf-explicit set + ancestry depth. Theme-response preserved: profiles with equal rendering but different override provenance are distinct. Stable anchors: insert-at-start adopts style, insert-inside extends, insert-before shifts, delete intersects/clamps. runs() is boundary-based (formatting can only change at delta boundaries) — algorithmic fix applied after the per-position scan hung the fuzz test.

results.unit_tests: 221 passed, 0 failed (31 suites; fsc: 11 incl. 100k acceptance + 800-iter fuzz)
results.acceptance_100k: global recolour → run structure identical across base-profile change (compose-only); one-word weight → local reshape scope; insert inside variation #1 preserved anchors (100..120 → 100..123); 1000+ runs computable over 100k chars

notable_findings.runs_algorithm: Per-position format resolution (n queries × d deltas) hung the fuzz test on a 20KB object — replaced with boundary-based run computation per directive §7, which is the production design.
notable_findings.provenance_model: Explicit-property provenance is LEAF-local (a property set at an ancestor is inherited by descendants). Combined with ancestry depth this distinguishes the directive's 'explicitly assigned vs inherited' semantics without over-rejecting equivalent profiles.
